entries.text: After all this silence, when I saw you again, you looked even prettier than before. As if time has been painting you gently, while I stood still, just watching. The wind must have learned its grace from your walk, and the sun its glow from your smile. Every glance of yours felt like poetry unspoken, every breath of mine, just waiting for you. I saw the sparkle in your eyes, like constellations drawn only for me to lose. Your laughter spilled like music in the air, a melody I wanted to listen inside too. Even the silence around you spoke, like soft prayers whispered to the sky. And in that moment, I knew again— you are the reason beauty feels divine. You were a dream dressed in daylight, a verse my heart kept rewriting. And I, the quiet witness of your beauty, clinging to moments that were never mine.

TW: death, suicide

It's my friend's 2nd death anniversary day after. I have been crying for the last 3 days. He died by suicide on March 21st, 2024. He put this head on a rail track when the 2:10pm train approached. He was only 19. 

I am a college student living in a different city. I have been busy this week so I took out time today to call my family after like 5 days. I was feeling low and I thought seeing them might bring me comfort. But fuck no.
 
Ten seconds into the call they tell me that my neighbour died yesterday. He was 24. I wasn't friends with him, but I saw him around all my life. He had a heart attack. They tell me this and start talking about cholestrol and importance of eating healthy. I straight up tell them that I do not have the energy for this right now, it is my friend's death anniversary in 2 days. 

And they fucking proceed to lecture me instantly, ignoring what I just said. So you fucking tell me that someone my age died (I am 21 and my dead friend will forever 19), that I should eat healthy and I beg you to stop, I tell you it's my friend's anniversary, and you fucking proceed to lecture me. I tell them I don't want to listen to this, and they tell me YOU WILL HAVE TO LISTEN TO THIS, TO US.

Fuck you. Fuck you.

I cut the call and straight up told them that this is shitty and that I won't apologise for cutting the call this time. 

It has been 2+ hours and they haven't responded. I have enough money for now, I am not gonna be speaking to them for at least a week. They can fucking die.

I have been grieving and hurting so much right now. Now I am pissed as fuck too.
